data.heading: Where it started
data.description: Product launches moving through disconnected systems one stage at a time, with reporting that only looked backward.

blocks.title: Business problem
blocks.body: Engineering tracked launch work in its own issue tracker while the enterprise ran on ServiceNow, so every launch meant manual handoffs, data re-entry, and constant switching between forms. Status syncs needed 100% manual intervention.

blocks.title: No decision framework
blocks.body: Workflows ran strictly in sequence, so SKU and billing tasks sat idle while upstream stages finished, with zero parallel execution. Reporting was retrospective, with no live link between an execution bug and its effect on ServiceNow SLA milestones, and no live map of how tasks connected across systems.

blocks.title: Agivant's role
blocks.body: Workflow architecture, ServiceNow engineering, cross-system integration, and SLA framework design across the launch lifecycle

data.heading: What Agivant built
data.description: Agivant rebuilt the flow as an intelligent coexistence model: an orchestration engine in ServiceNow, kept in automated bi-directional sync with engineering's issue tracker. Intake and risk run in one lane while SKU management and NPI automation run in parallel lanes, and projects provision themselves. Value in days and weeks.

blocks.title: Automated bi-directional sync
blocks.body: Status and updates move between the engineering issue tracker and ServiceNow on their own, ending manual status checks.

blocks.title: Parallel orchestration lanes
blocks.body: Intake and risk in one lane, SKU management and NPI automation forked in parallel, so downstream work starts early.

blocks.title: Intelligent triage and routing
blocks.body: Requests are triaged automatically, and non-standard ones skip the stages that do not apply to them.

blocks.title: Automated project provisioning
blocks.body: Projects and tasks spawn for each team once intake clears, with no manual data entry.

blocks.title: Configuration lock at intake
blocks.body: Critical configurations lock after intake, cutting data-entry errors and cross-functional friction during launch windows.

blocks.title: Live node map and executive dashboards
blocks.body: Cross-system task hierarchy and SLA compliance tracked in real time for leadership.

blocks.title: Business-centric SLA framework
blocks.body: MTTA, MTTR on active working time, suspension time for external dependencies, and total lifecycle velocity.

blocks.title: Agile resource optimization
blocks.body: Intelligent workflow routing automatically bypasses irrelevant stages for non-standard requests, optimizing resource allocation and preventing high-value engineering talent from workflow stagnation.

blocks.title: Enterprise single source of truth
blocks.body: Centralized data governance mechanisms lock critical configurations post-intake, reducing data-entry errors and cross-functional friction during critical launch windows.

blocks.title: Before
blocks.body: An upstream issue tracker checked by hand, feeding a sequential intake, review, and SKU flow with high idle time.

blocks.title: After
blocks.body: An orchestration engine in automated sync with engineering, parallel SKU and NPI lanes, automated project provisioning, and live executive dashboards.

data.heading: Proof in production
data.description: A launch request arrives and is triaged automatically. SKU management and NPI automation fork in parallel as soon as intake and risk clear, and a non-standard request skips the stages it does not need. SLA clocks pause while work waits on an external vendor, so each team is measured on its own active time. Existing tickets finished on their original path while new requests used the eight-stage flow.

blocks.heading: Measured results
blocks.description: Leadership now sees true operational velocity, with SLA clocks that count only active work.

blocks.title: Reusable asset
blocks.body: The business-centric SLA framework, with active-time MTTR and dependency-aware clock pausing, carries to any cross-functional ServiceNow workflow, and the parallel-lane pattern fits any launch process built on sequential handoffs. Every build amplifies the next.

blocks.title: Challenges overcome
blocks.body: Switching to the new flow while legacy tickets stayed undisturbed, measuring every team fairly when much of the elapsed time sat with external vendors, and keeping senior engineers out of stages that did not apply to their requests.

Agivant's turnaround transformed our NPI onboarding from a fragmented checklist into a high-velocity orchestration engine. The seamless cross-platform integration and live visibility have fundamentally modernized how our global cross-functional teams launch products.
